messages:
Maya: who’s up for a casual Saturday spritz + ping-pong hang on the patio this weekend? thinking 4pm, bring snacks/drinks. weather looks good :sun_with_face:
Ethan: love it. 4pm works for me. can we also bring a portable speaker? :headphones:
Priya: count me in. can someone bring a couple of extra paddles? I only have one.
Sam: i’ve got 2 paddles and a spare net. also can bring a cooler. :beer:
Robin: i might be late — stuck with family thing until 5. still good to join after.
Maya: @Robin all good — we’ll keep a spot. how does everyone feel about BYOB vs ordering spritzers? quick poll: BYOB / group order
EventsBot: Poll created: “Saturday spritz hang — BYOB or group order?” Options: BYOB, Group order. Ends in 24h.
Priya: BYOB for me — easier.
Ethan: group order so we don’t have to lug bottles. any preferences? non-alc ok?
Sam: non-alc yes please. also maybe a small cheese board? i can bring one.
Maya: love the cheese board idea. @Sam you’re a hero. :cheese:
Robin: if we do group order, can we get a couple of bottled spritz alternatives (aperol and non-alc)?
Priya: +1 for aperol and NA options.
Ethan: i can handle ordering. lemme know who wants paid portion so I can Venmo later.
Maya: @Ethan amazing. RSVP please: reply with 'in' or 'maybe' and 'spritz group'/'BYOB'
Sam: in / group order
Priya: in / BYOB
Ethan: in / group order
Robin: maybe / group order (late arrival)
Maya: perfect. I'll post food/snack sign-up later. also bringing a few extra folding chairs.
Sam: can we also bring a tiny bracket scoreboard? friendly tourney? :trophy:
Priya: yes tournament!! loser's buy next round :wink:
Ethan: love it. quick note: patio closes at 9pm so plan accordingly.
Maya: noted. thanks y'all — will create the event on calendar and ping again tomorrow with final order link. :calendar:
EventsBot: Event created: "Patio Spritz & Ping-Pong" Saturday 16:00-21:00. RSVP: 4.
Robin: thanks! see y’all saturday :raised_hands:
